rules.description: CapsLock/' to right_control (which does not exist on Mac keyboards), right_control + letters → symbols & controls & numbers.

manipulators.description: capslock = esc(click) | right_control (hold, supports all modifiers)
' = ' | right_control (hold, only supports option)
right_control + w -> -
right_control + e -> _
right_control + r -> =
right_control + t -> +
right_control + y -> |
right_control + u -> [
right_control + i -> ]
right_control + o -> {
right_control + p -> }
right_control + enter -> \
right_control + space -> backspace

rules.description: shift then letters → yabai & system controls

manipulators.description: shift then q -> yabai focus space 1
shift then h -> yabai focus prev space
shift then j -> yabai last
shift then k -> yabai next
shift then l -> yabai focus next space
shift then ; -> yabai recent
shift then ' -> restart yabai

to.shell_command: /usr/local/bin/yabai --restart-service && sudo /usr/local/bin/yabai --load-sa && osascript -e 'display notification "restart yabai" with title "yabai"'

manipulators.description: shift then z -> yabai rotate clockwise
shift then x -> yabai equalize window sizes
shift then c -> yabai layout bsp
shift then v -> yabai layout stack
shift then b -> yabai layout float
shift then n -> yabai focus display 1
shift then m -> yabai focus display 2
shift then , -> yabai focus display 3
shift then . -> yabai info
shift then shift then q -> yabai move window to space 1
shift then shift then h -> yabai move window to prev space
shift then shift then j -> yabai toggle mouse follow

to.shell_command: if [[ $(/usr/local/bin/yabai -m config mouse_follows_focus) == "off" ]]; then /usr/local/bin/yabai -m config mouse_follows_focus on && osascript -e 'display notification "mouse follows focus: ON" with title "/usr/local/bin/yabai"'; else /usr/local/bin/yabai -m config mouse_follows_focus off && osascript -e 'display notification "mouse follows focus: OFF" with title "/usr/local/bin/yabai"'; fi

manipulators.description: shift then shift then l -> yabai move window to next space
shift then shift then n -> yabai move window to display 1
shift then shift then m -> yabai move window to display 2
shift then shift then , -> yabai move window to display 3
shift then shift then x -> yabai mirror on X-axis
shift then shift then y -> yabai mirror on Y-axis
shift then space -> yabai toggle window float

to.shell_command: /usr/local/bin/yabai -m window --toggle float && osascript -e 'display notification "toggle window float" with title "yabai"'

manipulators.description: shift then / -> focus Help menu

rules.description: shift as leader key (has to be put after the led keys' configurations)
